_comment: Emission-factor register for Case B. Every factor carries source, year, region, boundary and a verification status. 'verified' = read from the primary document in this work; 'secondary' = taken from sources that cite the primary, primary not opened; 'gap' = no defensible value found, user must supply. Values are never silently defaulted when status is 'gap'.

SG_2024.source: EMA, Singapore Energy Statistics, Table T2.3 Electricity Grid Emission Factor (data year 2024, revised)
SG_2024.boundary: Generation-weighted average CO2 per kWh net generation (operating margin); CO2 only
SG_2024.note: Read from SES_tabular.xlsx sheet T2.3 on 2026-11-02. Sheet note: 'The 2024 GEF has been revised from 0.402 kg CO2/kWh to 0.401 kg CO2/kWh.' 2023 = 0.412; 2025 = 0.404 (latest column).

CN_2022_national.source: 生态环境部、国家统计局公告 2024 年第 33 号：2022 年电力二氧化碳排放因子
CN_2022_national.note: Regional values in the same notice, e.g. East China 0.5617, Southern 0.3869.

SG_2025.source: EMA, Singapore Energy Statistics, Table T2.3 (data year 2025, latest column)
SG_2025.note: Read from SES_tabular.xlsx T2.3 on 2026-11-02 (0.40442, shown to 3 d.p.). Check whether EMA labels it provisional.

FeCl3_40pct_iron_oxide_route.source: INCOPA, Life Cycle Analysis of Leading Coagulants, Executive Summary (2013, rev. 2014)

PAM.note: Commercial database, not peer-reviewed; replace with ecoinvent or supplier EPD before formal use.

Fe3O4_nanocoagulant.note: Five LCA papers checked (Arteaga-Díaz 2019 Appl. Sci.; Patiño-Ruiz 2021 ACS Omega; Fuentes 2024 ACS Sustain. Chem. Eng.; Yunus 2025 RSC Sustain.; micromixer LCA PMC9230433). None accessible here reports a kg CO2e/kg value. User to supply with citation.

lower_bound.method: Precursor iron only: INCOPA FeCl3 (iron-oxide route) 0.395 kg CO2e per kg of 13.8 % Fe product = 2.862 kg CO2e/kg Fe; Fe3O4 is 72.36 % Fe by mass; 2.862 x 0.7236 = 2.07. Treats Fe2+ precursor as FeCl3-equivalent. Excludes NaOH, heating, washing, drying, nano-processing and silica coating.

reference_estimate.method: Bottom-up cradle-to-gate estimate for aqueous coprecipitation (FeCl2 + 2 FeCl3 + 8 NaOH -> Fe3O4 + 8 NaCl + 4 H2O), computed in carbon_audit.fe3o4_bottom_up() from stoichiometric reagent masses, NaOH excess, process water heated to reaction temperature, evaporation of wash-cake moisture, and auxiliary electricity. Reagent factors: FeCl3 INCOPA (anhydrous basis = 0.395/0.40); FeCl2 proxied by FeCl3 per kg Fe (no FeCl2 factor found); NaOH Euro Chlor 0.86. Energy via the selected grid factor. Excludes silica coating, packaging, transport and nano-specific processing.
reference_estimate.note: Value is filled at run time; see README for the default assumptions and the low/high range.

NaOH.source: Euro Chlor, An Eco-profile and Environmental Product Declaration of the European Chlor-Alkali Industry (data year 2011, published 2013)
NaOH.boundary: Cradle-to-gate; mass allocation (stoichiometric for salt); mercury/diaphragm/membrane mix
NaOH.note: Document does not state whether 'product' is 100 % NaOH or 50 % solution; applied here per kg NaOH 100 % (conservative if the basis is 50 %).

landfill_inert.note: UK DEFRA 2024 'major changes' document gives only percentage changes; the full factor table was not opened. Supply the factor for the actual disposal route (landfill, co-processing, reuse).

transport_hgv.note: Supply DEFRA/ecoinvent HGV factor and haul distance.

FeCl3_to_FeOH3.unit: kg Fe(OH)3 per kg anhydrous FeCl3
